text.description_html:
Don-Jo KP-12x34-630 12" x 34" Satin Stainless Steel Kick Plate

Large size commercial door kick plate primarily used in restaurants, warehouses and stores, but are popular in homes as well. Made of .050" thick high quality solid stainless steel for longevity. Packaged with stainless steel mounting screws for easy installation.

These stainless kick plates are Made in the USA by Don-Jo Manufacturing.

Specifications of Don-Jo KP-12x34-630 Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Plate Height: 12"
  • Plate Width: 34"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Mounting Holes: 12
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with Stainless Mounting Screws
  • Don-Jo KP-12x34-630 Dimensions (PDF)

Note: Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. If your door is 36" wide (35-3/4") you would install a 34"wide kick plate. Please measure your door/s for proper fit.

*Sold Individually.
